reviews.author: graeaehorror
reviews.content:
A wonderful character-driven, slow-burn psychological horror/thriller which premiered at 2025’s FrightFest in London.

Following the recent passing of his abusive mother, Eddie (Ben Probert), is offered the position of caretaker at an elite academy. He begins to form a close bond with Marie (Mackenzie Larsen), a cleaner at the same academy.

As the film progresses it’s clear that something isn’t right on these grounds and Eddie starts to see visions, namely the ghost of a young girl. It fast becomes evident that the Aberdeen family who run the school are not as they seem, hiding many skeletons in their closet.

Director Luke Tedder makes some great choices with The Caretaker, opting for calmer paced film that defies genre, twisting between supernatural and mystery, whilst avoiding familiar tropes to deliver a wonderful narrative. There’s time dedicated to build a believable world with well-defined characters.

Eddie is the most fascinating character here and holds every scene. Despite being non-verbal he manages to capture your imagination and attention throughout the whole film. You can see how broken he is in the first act with the faraway gaze telling more than any word could carry. This is a heartbreaking performance from Probert as we learn more about Eddie’s trauma and abuse ridden past.

The relationship with Marie is wonderful and you can see their chemistry as actors radiates through the screen. This happiness and acceptance are much needed for a character such as Eddie and proves to be an emotional arc to the story.

The care and attention to detail in creating a film like this is evident and makes The Caretaker a worthwhile watch.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Grieving the loss of his family, a man accepts a caretaker job at a prestigious academy, only to unravel the institution's deeply unsettling secrets.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Struggling to cope with recent personal tragedy, a man takes a job as the night caretaker at an exclusive private academy. Expecting quiet solitude to process his grief, he instead notices bizarre rituals and strange occurrences after hours. As his investigation deepens, he realizes the school's pristine reputation masks a sinister history. He must confront the dark forces lurking within the halls before he becomes their next victim.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Devastated by a sudden personal tragedy, a grieving man seeks a fresh start by taking a position as the facility caretaker at an elite, isolated boarding school. Initially, the solitude of the vast, historic grounds offers him a peaceful retreat from his painful memories. However, as night falls over the empty corridors, he begins to hear unsettling noises and uncovers hidden passages sealed away for decades. Driven by curiosity and growing dread, he unearths archival documents and unsettling artifacts detailing the academy's forgotten origins. He soon realizes that the elite faculty and prestigious board members are bound by a dark tradition that requires periodic sacrifices. Paranoia sets in as the spirits of past victims begin communicating with him through eerie visions. Caught between his fragile mental state and the horrifying reality around him, he fights to expose the truth. In a harrowing climax, he risks everything to break the cycle and escape the academy's malevolent grasp before he is permanently silenced.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Following a tragic personal loss, a man accepts a live-in caretaker position at an elite, centuries-old academy nestled far from society. What begins as a secluded routine maintenance job quickly devolves into a nerve-wracking ordeal as the quiet campus reveals an atmosphere steeped in dread. Unsettling encounters, mysterious locked doors, and strange nocturnal events force him to question his own sanity while peeling back the layers of the school's prestigious facade. Balancing psychological tension with chilling suspense, this horror-thriller explores grief, isolation, and the corrupting nature of absolute power hidden behind institutional perfection.
